title: Love Story of a Supermodel
productionRules: Use physically plausible lighting, lens behavior, and wardrobe materials.
Characters should read like photographed performers, not illustrated or synthetic avatars.
Favor cinematic scale, visual intent, and stronger standalone composition per shot.
genreRules: Keep the stakes emotional and intimate, not militarized, apocalyptic, or survival-driven.
Favor longing glances, proximity, and tenderness over confrontation or threat spectacle.
Preserve a luxury fashion-world aesthetic with couture wardrobe, production lights, and polished city surfaces.
Do not introduce tactical gear, weapons, dystopian ruins, or combat staging unless the source explicitly requests them.

characters.description: Tall, slender woman with high cheekbones and striking, emerald green eyes. Long, wavy auburn hair. Wears sophisticated, flowing silk dresses in muted jewel tones, often paired with simple, elegant jewelry. Appears effortlessly beautiful, but with a subtle weariness in her posture and expression that becomes more relaxed over time. Her fingers are delicate, eventually with slight paint smudges.

Medium build man, late 20s to early 30s, with kind, observant dark brown eyes and a permanent, gentle smile. Dark, slightly unruly curly hair. Wears practical, paint-splattered work clothes – a denim artist's smock over a simple t-shirt, worn canvas trousers, and sturdy boots. His hands are strong and agile, often stained with various paint colors.

continuityNotes: Valentina's hair style and makeup should remain consistent throughout, transitioning from polished to slightly more natural.
The street painter's clothing consistently shows paint splatters.
The lighting should convey the progression of time, from golden hour to morning light, and back to golden hour.
The Pont des Arts location should be consistently recognizable, with the same background elements.

scenes.title: Unseen Amongst Gold
scenes.lighting: Warm, diffused golden hour light from a low sun, casting long, soft shadows. The light backlights Valentina, creating a luminous halo effect.
scenes.location: Pont des Arts, Paris. The bridge's distinctive metal structure is visible, with the Seine reflecting the golden light in the background. Distant, blurry Parisian architecture. Wet cobblestones from a recent rain.
scenes.action: Valentina walks gracefully, her silk dress rippling around her. Her gaze is distant, thoughtful, a hint of weariness in her eyes. She is initially unaware of the painter. Her expression is serene but subtly melancholic.
scenes.colorPalette: Warm gold, soft amber, muted blues and greys of the distant city, shimmering silver of the water.
scenes.negative: No blurry faces, no modern logos, no crowd, no harsh shadows, no forced smile on Valentina.

scenes.title: A Canvas of Connection
scenes.lighting: Soft, consistent daylight, possibly late morning, with an even, diffuse quality. Gentle highlights on their faces.
scenes.location: Beside the Pont des Arts, near the painter’s easel. Stone bridge railing visible. A few discarded paint tubes on the ground. A half-eaten croissant wrapper.
scenes.action: Valentina sits casually on a small folding stool, slightly leaning towards the street painter, her expression genuinely amused. She watches his hands as he mixes colors on a palette, her own delicate fingers stained with a touch of blue paint. He looks up at her, a gentle smile on his face, his eyes full of earnest focus.
props: canvas with an unfinished painting (abstract shapes implying her form)
scenes.colorPalette: Earth tones from the paints, muted blues and greys, soft pinks and creams of their skin, light browns of the bread crumbs.
scenes.negative: No overexposed highlights, no artificial lighting, no distant crowds dominating the shot, no 'dirty' feeling, only subtle paint stains.

scenes.title: The Weight of Two Worlds

camera.angle: slightly high angle, then eye level

scenes.lighting: Late afternoon light, softer than golden hour, with a hint of melancholy. Shadows are lengthening but still soft.
scenes.location: Pont des Arts. Valentina stands alone at the bridge railing, looking out over the Seine. A sleek, black luxury car is visible in the distance on a nearby street, a driver waiting patiently beside it, hinting at her other life.
scenes.action: Valentina clutches a phone in her hand, but her gaze is fixed on the river. Her shoulders are slightly slumped, conveying a profound inner conflict. She looks genuinely torn, her emotions raw. She takes a deep, conflicted breath.
scenes.colorPalette: Subdued blues and greens of the river and sky, dark grey of the car, warm but fading light on her face.
scenes.negative: No other people on the bridge distracting from Valentina, no direct sunlight, no cheerful expression, no blurred phone brand names.

scenes.title: A Shared Portrait, A Silent Goodbye
scenes.lighting: Soft, diffuse morning light, slightly overcast but warm, emphasizing gentle forms and textures.
scenes.location: The street painter's spot on the Pont des Arts. His easel is central, angled towards Valentina from his perspective. The river and city are a soft, blurred background.
scenes.action: The street painter stands before his easel, his back mostly to the camera, revealing a freshly finished portrait on the canvas. Valentina stands opposite him, looking at the painting, her hand reaching out tentatively. A single tear tracks down her cheek, but a soft, knowing smile plays on her lips. He turns his head slightly to look at her, a gentle, sad smile on his face.
props: finished canvas portrait (depicting Valentina without glamour, capturing her true essence)
scenes.colorPalette: Muted earth tones of the painting, soft blues and creams of the morning, subtle greens of far-off trees.
scenes.negative: No overly dramatic weeping, no vibrant colors, no direct eye contact between them in this shot, no visible signs of tourist activity.

scenes.title: Echoes of Gold, Renewed Spirit
scenes.lighting: Warm, strong golden hour light reflecting in her eyes, almost as if it's originating from within her. Catchlights are bright and golden.
scenes.location: Interior of a moving train compartment, looking out. The window shows a blurred landscape passing by, implying motion. Her reflection in the glass is subtle.
scenes.action: Valentina’s eyes are open, focused, but deeply thoughtful. The previous weariness is gone, replaced by a profound warmth and quiet strength. A hint of a gentle smile plays on the very corner of her lips. Her eyes reflect the golden light, suggesting an inner glow and newly found perspective. She holds a rolled canvas painting protectively in her lap, just out of frame.
scenes.colorPalette: Dominant warm gold, amber, deep sienna reflecting in her eyes, contrasted with the darker, blurred blues and greens of the distant landscape.
scenes.negative: No harsh artificial light, no other passengers, no obvious reflections of camera equipment, no sadness or regret, only a knowing peace.
